[SWS_TcpIp_00400]
TCP sockets immediate release in an online state ⌈If
TCPIP_STATE_OFFLINE is requested, the current state of that EthIf controller is
TCPIP_STATE_ONLINE and TCP sockets are in the state SYN-SENT or LISTEN, the
TcpIp module shall immediately release TCP sockets without handshake as defined in
IETF RFC 793.⌋
